additional_types.note: Single primary classification is not proof that cards have no simultaneous additional classification.

background_asset.note: imageUrl does not establish a separate background/player asset or visual composition.

version_links.note: No name/ID arithmetic is used to infer other card versions or real people.

cards.note: Cards are released card versions, not a count of distinct real players. Listing fields are not the entire source/game detail schema.

image_validation.method: Serial HTTPS GET of the actual imageUrl; MIME, magic bytes and response byte length checked. URLs checked for every collected row; real image fetches are sampled.
image_validation.note: No image sample was fetched because the initial page request was denied.

limitations: Counts verify the observed list pagination, not an atomic upstream database snapshot or historical completeness beyond the source catalogue.
A source total deficit cannot identify the missing card IDs; IDs are never generated from numeric sequences.
Additional categories, OVR training/booster conditions, separate background assets and all version links require further field/detail research.
No production seed, application database or public deployment is changed.

source_ui_recheck.scope: Read-only normal page and its actually linked JS; no extra API attempts, auth-token call, cookie acquisition or credential/header changes.
